premises.text: Enterprises must protect source code and other proprietary data, but perimeter walls and alarms still get bypassed after the fact
premises.evidence_span: Walls can be bypassed, and alarms only alert you after the fact

premises.text: Ordinary encryption makes data unsearchable and unusable, forcing a choice between convenience and security
premises.evidence_span: encryption makes your data completely unsearchable and unusable

premises.text: Overnest provides practical searchable encryption (AES-256, cryptographer-vetted) so encrypted data can be searched without revealing the key
premises.evidence_span: Overnest allows you to search encrypted data as easily and as quickly as Google can search web pages, all without revealing your key

premises.text: Git Zero is encrypted Git hosting that encrypts source code and history, builds an encrypted index, and preserves the familiar Git workflow with one-command migration
premises.evidence_span: the world's first encrypted Git hosting that not only encrypts your source code, at the same time, allows you to search while it's all encrypted

premises.text: Users can password-protect and upload their encryption key so that not even Git Zero can use it
premises.evidence_span: nobody, not even Git Zero, can use it

domains.name: source code security vs encryption usability
searchable encryption and Git Zero hosting

value.text: Enterprises can encrypt source code in the cloud while still searching and using it in their normal Git workflow

causal_links.evidence_span: they have to make a choice between convenience and security
Encrypted search on an encrypted source code repository

notes: Demo steps (migrate, index, view, search) folded as cascade of Git Zero encrypted hosting (v1.5.1 §4.1.7). FireEye credentials and university/telecom traction excluded. Key custody kept separate as independently revisable trust condition.
